name: Very fast three beat Bruno's nightmare

body.h: In this pattern the feeder passes on one count and the walkers pass to the feeder on two count. The feeder starts in the giant's right hand hand!
Starting pattern for Anne: Ben self.
Starting pattern for Ben: Anne Clare.
Starting pattern for Clare: self Ben. After Anne walks forward and in front of Clare:
Pattern for Clare: self. After Clare walks to her right and Anne walks next to Ben, turning clockwise to face Clare:
Pattern for Clare: Ben Anne. After Ben walks forward and in front of Anne:
Pattern for Clare: Ben. After Anne walks to her left and Ben walks next to Clare, turning anticlockwise to face Anne:
This is just like the start of the pattern, except now Anne has taken on Ben's role, Ben has taken on Clare's role and Clare has taken on Anne's role.
Note: the diagram shows the whole pattern!
